narrative: Iran's IRGC naval operations in the Strait of Hormuz dominate weekend headlines after two oil tankers struck naval mines, setting up a safe-haven bid for the US Dollar and Crude Oil at Sunday's open. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1028; the widening Fed-ECB OIS carry differential (+146bp) and Middle East supply risks set up downside pressure for the euro into the Tokyo open. Meanwhile, USD/JPY closed Friday at 159.69, where elevated geopolitical risk are likely to extend gains despite upcoming Japan Q3 GDP data.
